name: vision_medical3d
title: MONAI 3-D UNet segmentation of abdominal CT: keyed dictionary transforms, cached volumes, DiceCELoss and sliding-window validation
origin: domain-vision round 2: the medical-imaging shape. Everything but torch.optim and torch.save is MONAI, which MLView has no knowledge table for - the question this program asks is whether the blindness is declared

forbidden.why: there is no sklearn transformer in this project
the training loader is built with shuffle=True
the validation loader is built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
val_transforms() contains no Rand* stage at all; the four random stages live in train_transforms()
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step
scaler.step(optimizer) runs every batch
the backward precedes the step
the only no_grad region is the decorated validate(), which contains no backward()
the epoch loss accumulates loss.item(), and the Dice is accumulated inside a DiceMetric object rather than as a running total
CosineAnnealingLR is an epoch schedule and scheduler.step() runs in the epoch loop
the scaler follows the full protocol: scale(loss).backward(), step(optimizer), update()
validate() calls model.eval() before the loop and model.train() on the way out
validate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator
the prediction is discretised by AsDiscrete(argmax=True) before it reaches the DiceMetric
there is no torch softmax and no torch CrossEntropyLoss; DiceCELoss applies its own softmax from a keyword, which is the documented MONAI contract
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
the model is moved with .to(device) and both keys of every batch are moved inside both loops
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
main() calls monai.utils.set_determinism(seed=...) AND torch.manual_seed(seed)
the split is read from dataset.json; nothing is split at run time
there is no nn.Module subclass in this workspace - the network comes from monai.networks.nets
the checkpoint saves model.state_dict()
